summary: The prepared base already accounts for all resolved EAGLE draft layers in automatic KV-pool sizing. Added an issue-specific eight-layer Inkling-style regression and a page-boundary case; no production correction was justified.

tests.what_was_measured: 43 pool-configurator tests passed, including a 65.45 GiB/eight-draft-layer regression proving the current auto-sized target plus draft footprint stays within budget while the reconstructed target-only heuristic exceeds it, and an independent page-boundary case.

One AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 performed FP32 matrix multiplication; compared with a CPU FP64-derived reference, max absolute error was 2.288818359375e-05 and mean absolute error was 1.189536646961642e-06. This only verifies the assigned GPU and ROCm execution environment.
Formatting/lint tool availability; the prepared interpreter has no ruff module. git diff --check passed separately.
Repository-configured checks passed, including ruff lint, ruff format, codespell, AST validation, and registered-test validation.

gpu_evidence: reports/j-82b29c89343f/raw/gfx950_torch_check.log identifies one AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 and records the numerical comparison.
remaining_limitations: No NVIDIA B300 hardware was available, so the original CUDA allocation failure was not reproduced end to end.
Inkling-NVFP4 weights were unavailable; model architecture execution, FP4/MXFP8 semantics, TP8, and the eight-GPU serving path remain unverified.
The gfx950 numerical check is environment evidence only and is not evidence that the B300/Inkling serving issue is fixed.
No native source changed and no native rebuild was applicable.
The prepared Python environment does not include ruff.
